coverageNote: Includes the eight Session 1 Paper 1 PDFs recovered as direct NTA-hosted files that passed complete verification. The 27 January Shift 2 and 29 January Shift 2 papers are deliberately not seeded because no direct, complete NTA PDF was independently verified. No third-party substitute is included.
verification: Every live NTA PDF was checked for Paper 1 identity, date and shift metadata, English and Hindi question versions, 90 unique questions numbered 1-90, 90 unique question IDs, all six Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry sections, page count, byte length, SHA-256 and complete visual rendering of all 894 pages. The 31 January Shift 1 export has one blank trailing page after question 90; no exam content is missing. The NTA exports expose possible-answer fields for numerical-response questions but contain no worked solutions.
